text.purpose: Evref-BL, which makes these tools, collects it so they can change to fit that use: tools nobody reaches, arguments agents expect but the tools do not take, answers that are too long, mistakes agents repair.
text.why: To change the tools from how agents use them, rather than from our own sessions alone.
text.retention: Elasticsearch keeps the spans in one index a month, under the lifecycle policy the import job installs, which deletes each index twelve months after it was made. Reports derived from them hold counts, never spans, and are kept.
